QuestInfo.name: We Meet Again, Olive
QuestInfo.0: Olive shows up right after you defeat the masked rabbit and retrieve the jewel. \r\n#rIf you fail, forfeit the quest and start A Serious Talk with Athena Pierce to try again.#k
QuestInfo.1: Olive shows up right after you defeat the masked rabbit and retrieve the jewel. Something about Olive feels...off.\r\n#rIf you fail, forfeit the quest and start A Serious Talk with Athena Pierce to try again.#k
QuestInfo.2: Olive shows up right after you defeat the masked rabbit and retrieve the jewel... But it wasn't Olive, after all! It was a man disguised as her! He got away with the jewel, too!

0.0: You got the jewel back! Oh, thank goodness, brave Explorer. I was delivering that jewel to Athena Pierce when someone snatched it right out of my hands! \r\n#L0##bHey, you seem a little nervous. You okay?#l\n#k
0.1: I'm perfectly fine! You're so sweet to ask!\r\n#L0##bSomething's up... You were never that nice to me back at Kerning City.#l\n#k
0.2: Heh, heh, heh. I guess you've caught me... \r\n#b(What the heck is happening to Olive?!)#k

no.0: Oh, you believe me? Then let me have that jewel!

yes.0: Muahahaha, this is who I really am! You like what you see? \r\n#b(Olive turned into a man!)#k
yes.1: I'll be taking that soul stone now...
